rule_name: Minimum Age Requirement
description: Applicant must be at least 16 for the Student route; under-16s use the Child Student visa.
user_message_if_failed: You must be 16+ for the Student visa.

rule_name: Valid Passport Required
description: A valid passport covering the intended stay is required.
condition: Holds a valid passport for the stay
user_message_if_failed: Renew your passport before applying if needed.

rule_name: CAS from Licensed Sponsor Required
description: A CAS from a UKVI-licensed Student Sponsor is mandatory; verify the sponsor on the public Register of Licensed Student Sponsors.
evidence_required: CAS reference number from a licensed sponsor
condition: Holds a valid CAS from a licensed sponsor
user_message_if_failed: No valid CAS = no application. Verify your sponsor is licensed.

rule_name: CAS Must Be Unspent and Match Personal Details Exactly
description: The CAS must be unused and all details (name, DOB, passport, course, fees, dates) must match the application and passport exactly.
user_message_if_failed: Any CAS mismatch or reuse causes refusal. Reconcile every field before applying.

rule_name: CAS Must Not Be Older Than 6 Months (Outside UK Applicants)
description: For outside-UK applications, the CAS must have been issued within the last 6 months.
user_message_if_failed: Request a fresh CAS if yours is over 6 months old.

rule_name: Course Must Be at RQF Level 3 or Above
description: The course must be at RQF Level 3 or above.
user_message_if_failed: Courses below RQF 3 are not eligible.

rule_name: Sufficient Maintenance Funds Required
description: Must show (first-year tuition minus deposit) + living costs: £1,529/mo London or £1,171/mo outside, max 9 months (£13,761 / £10,539), for applications on/after 11 Nov 2025. Funds must be genuine and accessible.
user_message_if_failed: Show tuition balance + £13,761 (London) / £10,539 (outside). Underfunding causes refusal. Verify current figures before applying.

rule_name: 28-Day Continuous Funds Holding Rule
description: Maintenance funds must be held continuously for 28 days, never dropping below the required total, with the statement closing date within 31 days of application.
evidence_required: 28-day bank statement; closing date within 31 days
user_message_if_failed: The balance must never dip below the required amount across a 28-day window. A late large deposit fails this.

rule_name: Financial Evidence Must Be Genuine, Sourced and Correctly Held
description: Funds must be in the applicant's own account or a parent's/legal guardian's account (with relationship proof + consent). Third-party (sibling/uncle/friend) funds are not accepted directly. Source of significant funds must be documentable.
evidence_required: Account ownership proof; FRC/birth certificate + consent letter if parental; source-of-funds evidence
condition: Funds held in an accepted account, source documentable
user_message_if_failed: Only your own or a parent/guardian's funds count, with relationship proof and consent. Document the source of significant money.

rule_name: Secure English Language Test (SELT) Required
description: Below-degree courses require a SELT from a UKVI-approved provider (general IELTS not accepted). Degree-level courses may rely on a university assessment recorded on the CAS, unless exempt.
evidence_required: UKVI SELT result or CAS-recorded university assessment
condition: Valid English evidence for the course level
user_message_if_failed: Use a UKVI-approved SELT (or valid university assessment on the CAS). General IELTS is not accepted for below-degree courses.

rule_name: Minimum CEFR Level by Course Level
description: Minimum CEFR: B1 (~IELTS 4.0) for RQF 3-5; B2 (~IELTS 5.5) for degree level RQF 6+.
evidence_required: Test result meeting the CEFR level
user_message_if_failed: Your English must meet the level for your course (B1 below degree, B2 at degree level).

rule_name: SELT Result Must Not Be More Than 2 Years Old
description: A SELT must be no more than 2 years old at application.
user_message_if_failed: A SELT over 2 years old is invalid; retake it.

rule_name: TB Test Mandatory for Pakistani Applicants (6+ Month Stay)
description: A TB certificate from a UKVI-approved clinic (e.g. IOM in Pakistan) is mandatory for Pakistani applicants staying 6+ months. A normal hospital X-ray does not count.
evidence_required: TB certificate from an approved clinic
condition: Holds a valid TB certificate where required
user_message_if_failed: A TB test from a UKVI-approved clinic is mandatory for 6+ month stays. Missing it = refusal.

rule_name: ATAS Certificate Required for Sensitive STEM Postgraduate Subjects
description: Sensitive STEM postgraduate courses require an ATAS certificate obtained before applying; the CAS/offer states if required.
user_message_if_failed: Obtain ATAS before applying if your course requires it.

rule_name: Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) Must Be Paid Upfront
description: The Immigration Health Surcharge (~£776/year, student rate) must be paid in full upfront during the application; no instalments.
user_message_if_failed: Pay the IHS (~£776/year) in full during the application — it can't be paid later.

rule_name: Genuine Student / Credibility Assessment
description: The applicant should be a genuine student able to explain (in a credibility interview if held) why the UK/this university/course, course details, ties, and career plan, consistently with their documents.
user_message_if_failed: Be ready to explain your course choice, funding, and plans in your own words, consistently with your documents.

rule_name: Educational Consistency and Academic Progression
description: Education/employment history should be consistent with clear academic progression; 12+ month gaps, downgrades, and drastic field changes must be justified, and academic records must be complete and verifiable.
evidence_required: Attested transcripts, gap evidence, progression rationale
user_message_if_failed: Justify gaps, downgrades, and field switches with evidence; have complete, verifiable academics.

rule_name: Application, CAS and Document Consistency
description: Name, DOB, and all details must match across passport, CAS, academic documents, financial evidence, and the application form. Contradictions are treated as adverse.
condition: All documents consistent with the passport
user_message_if_failed: Reconcile name/DOB/course/fee/date details across every document before applying.

rule_name: Full Immigration History Must Be Accurately Disclosed
description: All prior refusals, overstays, removals, and asylum claims (any country) must be disclosed accurately. Concealment is deception with a 10-year UK ban risk.
evidence_required: Accurate disclosure; explanation of prior refusals
user_message_if_failed: Disclose every refusal/overstay/removal/asylum claim. Concealment = 10-year ban risk.

rule_name: Dependants Restricted to PhD/Research Students (From 1 Jan 2024)
description: Since 1 Jan 2024, only full-time PhD/research-degree (9+ months) students, or government-sponsored students on 6+ month courses, may bring dependants. Taught Masters/UG/sub-degree cannot. Only a partner and children under 18 qualify.
evidence_required: CAS showing PhD/research level; relationship proof; dependant funds
user_message_if_failed: Most taught-course students can no longer bring dependants. Confirm your course qualifies.

rule_name: Application Integrity and Agent Risk
description: The applicant is responsible for everything submitted in their name, including by an agent. Fabricated documents or agent-advised concealment cause refusal and a 10-year deception ban.
condition: Verified all submissions; no fabricated documents
user_message_if_failed: Verify every document yourself. Agent-fabricated content or hidden facts make YOU liable for a 10-year ban.

rule_name: Student Visa Work Rights Depend on Course Level and Sponsor Status
description: UK Student visa holders may have restricted or no work rights depending on their course level (RQF 3–5 versus degree) and whether the sponsoring institution holds a UKVI track record. Working outside permitted conditions is a visa condition breach. Specific hour limits and exceptions are subject to change; applicants must verify current entitlements on GOV.UK before beginning any employment.
applies_to: All student visa holders considering employment in the UK
evidence_required: Awareness of current work entitlement; no documentary evidence required at application stage
condition: Applicant understands that work rights are not automatic and vary by course level and sponsor status, and will verify conditions before working
user_message_if_failed: Do not assume you have work rights on the UK Student visa. Your entitlement depends on your course level and your institution's UKVI sponsor status. Verify current conditions on GOV.UK before beginning any employment.
